description: Keyword search across Connect REST endpoints, SDK methods, concept guides and data models. Space-separated keywords; common synonyms match (meeting -> conference, login -> authorize). Results matching every keyword come first; when none does, results matching some keywords are returned with match "partial" and the words nothing matched in unmatchedWords. Results sorted by relevance.

language.description: Restrict SDK matches to one language. Endpoints, guides and models are always searched.

name: searchConnect
title: Search Connect API and SDKs
